01

The Keyboard That Speaks

टाइप गर्नुहोस्

Devanagari is an abugida: every consonant already contains an "a". Type Roman letters and watch the script assemble itself — matras first, consonants second.

02

The Calendar Nepal Actually Uses

बिक्रम सम्बत

Bikram Sambat runs ~56.7 years ahead of the Gregorian calendar, and its months are astronomically determined — every year has a different length. This is the real table, 2000–2090 BS.
